name: occupancy_leave_one_seed_out
caption: Leave-one-seed-out F4 gaps on the committed last-band seed-pair matrix. Each row drops one of the ten seed texts and recomputes mean(between) − mean(within) on the rest.
alt_text: Leave-one-seed-out F4 gaps on the committed last-band seed-pair matrix. Each row drops one of the ten seed texts and recomputes mean(between) − mean(within) on the rest.
limitations: physics s1 has no last-band within diagonal (n_within_pairs=9). Leave-one-seed-out and within-pair randomisation are tests on these ten texts. They do not replace trajectory-bootstrap CIs. Do not read a cluster count off UMAP. Domain ≡ seed instance (ADR-0020).
